copy.value: Brightmore brings Mattamy Homes' thoughtful brand of active and spirited 55+ living to the top master-planned community of Wellen Park. Discover a fresh new 55+ lifestyle like no other in this community that is rooted in well-being, new possibilities and connections. Brightmore's premier location in Venice, Florida, is in the heart of Wellen Park's robust lifestyle, which includes the popular destination, Downtown Wellen, with lakefront dining, shopping and entertainment for all ages. Live only15 minutes from beautiful beaches, and be surrounded by golf courses, parks, shopping, dining and more. Stylish paired villa and single-family homes in this low-maintenance, gated setting are complemented by 11 acres of vacation-style amenities that are well under construction. These vibrant amenities include an expansive clubhouse with fitness center and social hall, resort-style pool, lap pool, spa, 9 pickleball courts, paw park, indoor and outdoor gathering areas and much more. Discover something new every day with a full selection of experiences and adventures, activities, classes, clubs and events. Living Beyond. Living Bright. Looking for more options? Discover our additional homes in Wellen Park-each offering comfort and convenience in thriving Southwest Florida.

multiBlocks.title: A New Home and a Free Golf Cart? Yes, Really.
multiBlocks.text: For a limited time, select new to-be-built homes at Brightmore include a complimentary golf cart—bringing added ease, connection, and fun to everyday living. Available on select homesites only and while supplies last.

multiBlocks.title: State-of-the-art clubhouse surrounded by lavish lifestyle amenities!
multiBlocks.text: Brightmore's 11 acres of exclusive amenities are the heart of the community.

image.alt: Brightmore Amenity Aerial

secondCTA.text: View Amenity Grand Opening + Ribbon Cutting

multiBlocks.title: Resort-inspired pool alongside a full-length lap pool
multiBlocks.text: Indulge year-round in the sparkling resort pool, while a dedicated lap pool keeps fitness close at hand.

image.alt: Brightmore Amenity Center Pool

multiBlocks.title: Championship-style pickleball courts
multiBlocks.text: Enjoy friendly competition with neighbors on the 8 pickleball courts, or take center stage on the stadium court to show off your skills.

image.alt: Brightmore Amenity Center Tennis courts with chairs

multiBlocks.title: Resort-style clubhouse
multiBlocks.text: The beautifully designed clubhouse offers versatile indoor and outdoor gathering areas for daily activities and events, highlighted by a grand hall, clubroom, fitness studios, and a stylish outdoor café.

image.alt: Brightmore Amenity Center Interior

multiBlocks.title: Cutting-edge fitness facility
multiBlocks.text: Maintain your wellness routine in the private community fitness center, equipped with state-of-the-art cardio and strength-training equipment.

image.alt: Community Club with window and carpet

multiBlocks.title: Studio for group fitness complemented by an open-air yoga lawn
multiBlocks.text: Energize with a class in the group fitness studio, or find tranquility on the serene outdoor yoga lawn.

image.alt: Brightmore Amenity Center Gym with brick walls

multiBlocks.title: Resident Café & Bar
multiBlocks.text: Unwind with friends at the poolside café and bar, where gourmet bites and refreshing drinks meet a luxurious setting.

image.alt: Community Club with window, tile flooring and stone flooring

multiBlocks.title: Lifestyle events & activities
multiBlocks.text: Enjoy inspired events, classes, clubs and a fun-filled schedule year-round with a full-time lifestyle director.

image.alt: Lifestyle

multiBlocks.title: Private Paw Park
multiBlocks.text: A secure, fenced green space where your pets can play, socialize, and roam freely.

image.alt: Lifestyle

multiBlocks.title: Wellen Park
multiBlocks.text: As one of the top master-planned communities in the Nation, Wellen Park offers energizing amenities and makes it easy for residents to have a fun-loving lifestyle. The good vibes and fun times are catching, and the natural beauty of this area is boundless and breathtaking.

image.alt: downtown wellen waterfront with live band

multiBlocks.title: Downtown Wellen
multiBlocks.text: A must-visit hotspot, Downtown Wellen is the social hub of the community. This welcoming, walkable destination is home to great eateries, stylish shops, exciting entertainment, and stunning sunsets. The magical, pedestrian-friendly downtown celebrates a waterfront vibe with the 80-acre Grand Lake providing a scenic backdrop and opportunities for fishing and paddle sports. Visitors can also enjoy time along the 3-mile lakefront trail, great live music and endless entertainment.

image.alt: downtown wellen farmers market

multiBlocks.title: Dining
multiBlocks.text: Explore endless dining options at Downtown Wellen. From restaurants and bistros such as The Banyan House, Oak & Stone, Acqua Pazza and Villani & Co to The Yard - a great spot to grab casual on-the-go bites served from repurposed shipping containers. Top it all off with a treat from Foxtail Coffee Co. or a scoop from Bright Ice. There is something for everyone to enjoy.

image.alt: Lifestyle

multiBlocks.title: Shopping and services
multiBlocks.text: A number of new shops and services have opened at Downtown Wellen with more on the way, including Breakwater Home Fashions, Naples Soap Company, Dana Typer Boutique and Paint Nail Bar. In addition, Marketplace Shopping Center on US-41 is anchored by a Publix Super Market and offers a variety of local restaurants, coffee shop, bank, family dentistry, animal clinic and more. A new Costco has just opened in Wellen Park providing an additional shopping option for local residents.

image.alt: Lifestyle with , carpet

multiBlocks.title: CoolToday Park
multiBlocks.text: Brightmore is adjacent (just south) of this exciting destination. The Atlanta Braves hold their spring training at this new, state-of-the-art sports and entertainment complex, CoolToday Park. Year-round, Wellen Park residents enjoy the facility’s public plaza and its surrounding multi-purpose fields for fun events like concerts, sports games, farmers’ markets, art shows and more. The Tomahawk Tiki Bar is a great place to grab a meal, meet for happy hour or catch live music.<br class="t-last-br" />

image.alt: Amenities

multiBlocks.title: Inspired health and well-being
multiBlocks.text: Wellen Park is a hub for all things health and well-being with a community focus on living well. Explore classes and programs fit for all, an extensive trail network and nearby, parks and recreation. A new 75,000 square foot medical center in Wellen Park is anticipated to open in 2025.

image.alt: Lifestyle

multiBlocks.title: Marketplace
multiBlocks.text: Located at West Villages Parkway and U.S. 41, this shopping plaza is anchored by Publix Super Market and offers a variety of convenient dining such as Irma's Tacos, Fuji Sushi, Bocca Lupo Pizza, and services including Ace Hardware, UPS Store, an animal clinic and more. In addition, a new Costco has just opened in Wellen Park.

image.alt: shopping center with publix super market

multiBlocks.title: Golf and country clubs
multiBlocks.text: Wellen Park is surrounded by many 18-hole golf courses, both public and private.

image.alt: Lifestyle

multiBlocks.title: Trail network
multiBlocks.text: Wellen Park is home to an extensive network of over 30 miles of trails for walking, biking, or enjoying nature.

image.alt: trail_network_amenity_couple_riding_their_bicycles_resized

multiBlocks.title: Beaches
multiBlocks.text: Here, good vibes run free, with some of Florida's most beautiful beaches less than a 15-minute drive away, including Venice Beach, Blind Pass Beach and Caspersen Beach Park.<br class="t-last-br" />

image.alt: Lifestyle

multiBlocks.title: Airports
multiBlocks.text: With four major airports nearby, including Sarasota Bradenton International and Tampa International, Wellen Park's location makes travel a breeze.<br class="t-last-br" />

image.alt: TPA_WellenPark_Features_Airports

multiBlocks.title: 100 Best Places to Live for 2024
multiBlocks.text: Brightmore was recently named as one of the 100 Best Places to Live by Ideal-Living in 2024. Each year, 100 communities across the U.S. and internationally are chosen based on amenities, sense of community, low maintenance living and sought-after lifestyle.

multiBlocks.title: HERS Index
multiBlocks.text:
The Home Energy Rating System (HERS) is the industry standard scoring system that measures a home’s energy efficiency on a scale from zero to 150. A typical existing home score is 130 and a typical new home is 100.

 

Brightmore at Wellen Park has an average HERS score of 66. The lower the HERS score the more you save! Click below to learn more.

value.name: Brightmore at Wellen Park
value.description: Brightmore brings Mattamy Homes' thoughtful brand of active and spirited 55+ living to the top master-planned community of Wellen Park. Discover a fresh new 55+ lifestyle like no other in this community that is rooted in well-being, new possibilities and connections. Brightmore's premier location in Venice, Florida, is in the heart of Wellen Park's robust lifestyle, which includes the popular destination, Downtown Wellen, with lakefront dining, shopping and entertainment for all ages. Live only15 minutes from beautiful beaches, and be surrounded by golf courses, parks, shopping, dining and more. Stylish paired villa and single-family homes in this low-maintenance, gated setting are complemented by 11 acres of vacation-style amenities that are well under construction. These vibrant amenities include an expansive clubhouse with fitness center and social hall, resort-style pool, lap pool, spa, 9 pickleball courts, paw park, indoor and outdoor gathering areas and much more. Discover something new every day with a full selection of experiences and adventures, activities, classes, clubs and events. Living Beyond. Living Bright. Looking for more options? Discover our additional homes in Wellen Park-each offering comfort and convenience in thriving Southwest Florida.
